summary: Redeem's verified path ignores quarantine — a recovered chain re-admits a quarantine-admitted ticket
description: Pre-existing gap found by TKT-73's adversarial review (R2), verified at HEAD: Redeem checks quarantine only inside degradedScan; the verified path (postgres.go:263-282) checks lifecycle_events alone. A ticket that took its one degraded admission under a verifier bug (ADR-021 §D6) gets admitted a SECOND time once the chain verifies clean again (e.g. the bad verifier build is reverted) — violating §D6's admit-once. Fix: the verified redemption path must consult the quarantine table under the ticket lock and deny (DecisionIntegrityQuarantined, original admitted_at). ADR-025 §D2 names this: admission decisions consult trace ∪ quarantine, not the trace alone. Test: degraded admission → restore verification → distinct subsequent scan is denied. Seams: lifecycle_smoke_test.go.
